unitSeparation.retainedEventCandidate: one distinct production cluster with a retained event row, regardless of publication or review outcome
unitSeparation.systemNegative: one retained exclusion outcome or unresolved raw candidate
unitSeparation.countryDay: one sovereign jurisdiction on one UTC calendar date

precision.rule: report design-based intervals; never replace observed design effect with the planning value

frames.populationRule: all event rows created by the freeze time whose event date is inside the period, deduplicated by cluster
frames.estimandRole: finite-period event-candidate precision and error analysis

frames.populationRule: retained exclusion outcomes whose candidate is outside the event census, plus raw candidates retrieved by the freeze time that have no event-source link
frames.estimandRole: false-negative, abstention, invalid-input, and deduplication error analysis

frames.populationRule: every sovereign-state jurisdiction crossed with every UTC date in the frozen period

balancingMargins.crossingRule: balance margins separately; do not require a sparse full cross-product

selection.replacement: next hash-ranked reserve in the same primary stratum

analysis.generalizedAccuracy: requires design weights plus item/country clustering or a declared mixed model
analysis.rareMargins: report insufficient evidence when valid n is below 30
analysis.multiplicity: headline overall metrics primary; subgroup results descriptive with intervals
